description: This file contains JUnit test cases for the ResumeSource class in the Akka stream control flow package, specifically testing its behavior such as cancellation, completion, resumption after errors, and failure handling.

classes.name: ResumeSourceTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for verifying the behavior of the ResumeSource component in Akka streams, including tests for cancellation, completion, resumption after errors, and failure scenarios.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the actor system and prepares the test source and sink for testing before each test case.

methods.name: cleanup
methods.description: Shuts down the actor system after each test case.

methods.name: testCancellation
methods.description: Tests that the ResumeSource correctly handles stream cancellation.

methods.name: testCompletion
methods.description: Tests that the ResumeSource correctly handles stream completion.

methods.name: testResumption
methods.description: Verifies that ResumeSource resumes correctly after errors and handles subsequent data flow correctly.

methods.name: testFailureAfterMaxRestarts
methods.description: Ensures that the source fails after exceeding the maximum number of restarts.

methods.name: rematerializeSource
methods.description: Helper method to recreate the test source for multiple test scenarios.
